attchmntText: THEINVEST: The Investment Trust of India Limited has informed the Exchange about a copy of the newspaper publication regarding its Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: The Investment Trust Of India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr. Rashesh Praful Shah as the Manager, Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) and Senior Management Personnel (SMP) of the Company w.e.f. November 04, 2026.

attchmntText: The Investment Trust Of India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: The Investment Trust Of India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 04, 2026 regarding the appointment of Manager as Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) and Senior Management Personnel (SMP) of the Company.
